meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将高通量测序数据转化为可视化分析图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析ChIP-seq、RNA-seq或ATAC-seq数据
copy.tagline_en: Transform high-throughput sequencing data into visualization and analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or ATAC-seq data

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能处理测序数据：把 BAM 转成 bigWig 覆盖文件，做相关性、PCA、指纹图等质控，生成 TSS 或峰值的热图与图谱，还会校验输入文件、生成工作流脚本。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 BAM/bigWig/BED 等测序文件、做质量控制（如检查 ChIP 质量、比较重复样本），或生成热图/图谱等可视化时触发。

say.text: 把 sample.bam 转成 bigWig，用 RPGC 归一化
say.note: 会调用 bamCoverage 生成 bigWig 文件

say.text: 对这两个 BAM 做相关性分析，并画出热图
帮我生成一个 ChIP-seq QC 工作流脚本

howto.what_en: Adds NGS analysis abilities: converts BAM to bigWig coverage, runs QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), makes heatmaps/profiles around TSS or peaks, and provides file validation and workflow generation scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask to process BAM/bigWig/BED files, perform quality control (e.g., ChIP QC, replicate comparison), or generate heatmaps/profile plots for visualization.

say_en.text: Convert sample.bam to bigWig with RPGC normalization.
say_en.note: Calls bamCoverage and produces a bigWig file.

say_en.text: Run correlation analysis on these two BAM files and plot a heatmap.
Generate a ChIP-seq QC workflow script.
